flags.message: claude-baseline, gemini-baseline, and codex-baseline all report a blank 12-page application with empty_text=true and ocr_derived=false at prediction time. The evaluator's current manifest instead has empty_text=false and ocr_derived=true, with readable application text and an Eleventh Circuit docket. The candidate-stage text/manifest is not staged for direct comparison. This information-set difference matters: the current filing identifies appellate stay proceedings that some rationales inferred were bypassed. Evaluations distinguish unsupported inference from inability to read unavailable text; preserve candidate-stage extraction provenance for audit.
